description: One custom field's value, hidden ones included, from a login or a secure note: a secret that is not a password, such as a licence key or an API token, kept where a person put it. get_login names an item's fields. Use it only to type or pipe the value where it goes: never write it into a file, a commit, a message, a log or a reply.

field.description: The field's name as get_login lists it (case does not matter).

name: get_field
title: Get field
